purpose: Bound independent webhook dispatch, stop/drain failures, preserve atomic reservations and enforce full release verification

verification.candidate: Combined working candidate with separate GitHub dispatch follow-up
initialRepairedFailures: Initial approval unit case exceeded its five-second timeout during server-module import; fixture startup now uses beforeAll, individual request timeout preserved.
Default UUID path exposed existing detached WebCrypto receiver failure; fallback now calls crypto.randomUUID on its receiver.

measurement.scenario: Four independent deployment rows, injected 40ms queue IO, no AWS requests

limitations: At most one sibling dispatch can already be in flight when an error stops further admission.
Two pipelines per webhook is not a global queue/compute/spending limit.
Synthetic latency samples are not AWS performance evidence.
Remaining private MVP integration and hosted release gates are not completed by this cleanup.
